agreed_players.definition: player-games projected by every version (the shadows from the same refresh); all metrics above are on these only

disagreement_players.note: Excluded = the version made no projection. An excluded player who sat is a correct exclusion (availability), not an accurate prediction; an excluded player who played is a miss. Accuracy is graded only for versions that projected a player who played.

note: Shadow evaluation on the test site: identical player-games, last pre-game record per version from the same refresh, players who played. Nothing here is published to users; the ledger is read, never changed.
